label: Complementary Products
purpose: Show related or complementary products the shopper might also want
_notes: The recommended products themselves are pulled automatically from Shopify's product recommendations, not authored — block_heading (e.g. 'You may also like', 'Complete the look') is the only real copy. enable_quick_add toggles a quick add-to-cart button on each recommended product card. Icon choice, pagination style, image ratio, card sizing and product-count limits are layout/behavioral settings and intentionally excluded.
